name: Proxy Chains & SOCKS Routing
description: Ability to route tools and traffic through proxy chains for multi-hop network access. Covers proxychains configuration, SOCKS4/5 proxy setup, tool-specific proxy settings, and the operational management of proxy infrastructure during engagements.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to proxy chains or SOCKS routing

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the concept of proxy chains and why they are used for pivoting
evidence: Can explain SOCKS proxy protocols and their role in routing tool traffic through pivot hosts
Understands how proxychains routes tool traffic through intermediary hosts
Knows why multi-hop proxy chains are necessary in segmented networks

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Configures and uses basic proxy chains under supervision
evidence: Configures proxychains.conf for single-hop SOCKS proxying
Routes Nmap, NetExec, or similar tools through proxychains
Understands which tools work reliably through proxychains and which do not
Documents proxy configurations and routing paths under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently manages proxy infrastructure for multi-segment access during engagements
evidence: Configures multi-hop proxy chains through several pivot points
Handles tool compatibility issues and selects alternatives when proxychains fails
Maintains proxy infrastructure stability throughout an engagement
Routes both scanning and exploitation tools through proxy chains reliably

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Manages complex proxy architectures; optimizes performance; mentors others
evidence: Designs proxy architectures for large engagements with many network segments
Configures transparent proxying and traffic routing for tools that lack proxy support
Troubleshoots complex proxy chain failures across multiple hops
Mentors junior staff on proxy chain setup and management

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines proxy methodology; develops routing solutions; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's proxy chain and routing methodology
Develops custom proxy routing solutions for specialized engagement scenarios
Deep understanding of SOCKS protocol internals and limitations
Trains teams on advanced proxy architecture and traffic management

assessment_methods.description: Configure a multi-hop proxy chain and successfully run scanning and exploitation tools against a target three network hops away
Observe proxy chain setup and management during a live or simulated engagement
